    html:
        theme: [default]
        embed-resources: true
        code-fold: true
params:
  tf_rank_filename: "output_2/calc_rank_score/tf_rank_HINT.tsv"
---


```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(here)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
library(rlang)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
theme_sovacool <- ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, 'lines'),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.placement = 'outside'
    )
theme_set(theme_sovacool)
set.seed(20241205)

dat <- read_tsv(here(params$tf_rank_filename))
```

```{r plot_col}
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6.5
top_c1 <- dat %>% filter(cluster_id == 'c1', TF_rank <= 25) 
dat %>% filter(TF_rank <= 25) %>% 
    mutate(gene_name = fct_reorder(gene_name, desc(TF_rank))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(c(rank_A_diff, rank_O_diff, rank_E_diff, TF_rank), 
                 names_to = 'metric', values_to = 'rank') %>% 
    mutate(metric = case_when(
        metric == 'rank_A_diff' ~ 'Accessibility',
        metric == 'rank_E_diff' ~ 'Expression',
        metric == 'rank_O_diff' ~ 'Outdegree',
        metric == 'TF_rank' ~ 'Overall TF rank',
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% fct_relevel(c('Outdegree','Expression','Accessibility','Overall TF rank'))) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = gene_name, fill = metric)) + 
    geom_col() +
    facet_grid(metric ~ cluster_id, scales = 'free_y')
```
